gems.title: 安昂传奇：最后的气宗
gems.summary: 派拉蒙和尼克宣布“降世神通”系列开发三部新的电影，仍是动画形式。第一部由《降世神通：最后的气宗》导演Lauren Montgomery执导，《最后的气宗》主创Bryan Konietzko和Michael DiMartino担任制片人。
gems.summaryEn: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls i
gems.whyWatch: 动画形式的降世神通回归，情怀与史诗感兼具，值得所有粉丝期待。
gems.whyWatchEn: A returning animated Avatar saga full of epic wonder and nostalgia—deserves every fan's attention.
gems.audience: 降世神通粉丝、动画冒险片爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Avatar fans and animation adventure lovers

gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 改编自同名荷马史诗，讲述奥德修斯的故事，以及他在特洛伊战争后10年的回家之旅。
gems.summaryEn: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters,
gems.whyWatch: 荷马史诗的宏大改编，奥德修斯十年归途充满神话魅力与人性深度。
gems.whyWatchEn: A monumental Homeric adaptation that turns Odysseus's ten-year journey into mythic, deeply human storytelling.
gems.audience: 古典文学爱好者、史诗冒险片观众
gems.audienceEn: Classics enthusiasts and epic adventure audiences

gems.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日
gems.summary: 重建普通生活后，彼得一边在大学完成学业、一边从事兼职以维持生计，同时仍肩负着守护纽约街头的蜘蛛侠责任。然而，当一个神秘力量从内部腐蚀这座城市的安全与秩序，彼得被迫再次披上战衣。他必须在强大的敌人与昔日纽带之间找到平衡，并重新定义英雄的意义。
gems.summaryEn: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to
gems.whyWatch: 更接地气的蜘蛛侠成长故事，在校园、生计与英雄责任之间寻找全新平衡。
gems.whyWatchEn: A grounded Spider-Man coming-of-age tale balancing college life, part-time work, and the weight of heroism.
gems.audience: 蜘蛛侠粉丝、青春超级英雄电影爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Spider-Man fans and teen superhero movie lovers
